subject: Term upsell + portal checkpoint — supplier refresh and PO path
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — onboarding refresh + PO timing

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick checkpoint this morning. We reviewed the proposed term change (18 -> 24 months) and the recommended capacity uplift. Procurement asked for a very short evidence bundle and a pre-filled PO template to avoid delays with our legal/finance teams.

Can you confirm:
- A short list of the items NovaMed needs to upload to our portal to renew without a re-certification
- Whether the 10% commit uplift can be staged over two quarters (Oct–Dec)
- Any DocuSign link we should expect for the SOW amendment

Appreciate it — Elena

[Company: NovaMed Health]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — onboarding refresh + PO timing

Elena —

Great to hear the internal decision is moving toward the 24-month term. Quick answers below and next steps attached.

What NovaMed should upload to the portal (minimal evidence bundle):
- SOC2 attestation PDF (latest)
- Data residency confirmation spreadsheet (one line per region)
- Authorized signatory list (PDF)
- Short integration checklist showing where inference calls originate (1 page)

Staging the 10% commit uplift: yes, we can split the uplifts across two quarters. Proposed cadence: 5% effective 2028-11-01; additional 5% 2029-01-01. We will reflect this in the SOW amendment.

DocuSign: I will route you a DocuSign for the SOW amendment once legal signs off (target EOD Friday). In the meantime I attached a pre-filled PO template that your procurement team can use to accelerate the PO creation.

Attachments: NovaMed_SOW_rev2.pdf (SOW w/ staged uplift), renewal-evidence-bundle-2028-10-10.zip (evidence checklist + sample files)

Next steps:
1) Procurement uploads the listed items to the portal link below.
2) Jordan will push the DocuSign to you after legal review.
3) Marissa will confirm billing lane and invoicing cadence for a staged commit.

Portal upload link: https://portal.redwood.ai/novamed/renewals/DEAL-9834
Internal link to deal: https://console.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-9834

Thanks — talk soon.

— Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — onboarding refresh + PO timing

Elena —

Quick operational note from legal/ops: we can accept the SOC2 PDF and the signatory list directly in the procurement portal (no separate SFTP). Please use the following filenames when uploading to avoid manual reconciliation: NOVAMED_SOC2_2028.pdf, NOVAMED_SIGNATORIES_2028.pdf, NOVAMED_DATARESIDENCY.csv, NOVAMED_INTEGRATION_CHECK_1PAGE.pdf

DocuSign ETA: target Friday EOD but if procurement can pre-populate the PO fields in the portal (vendor name, billing address, billing contact, PO number), we can send DocuSign concurrently and reduce approval loop time.

FWIW, I just created the pre-filled PO (internal) and linked it into the portal — please paste your PO number into the portal field and hit submit.

— Jordan Blake
Director, Customer Success Ops

From: procurement@novamed.com <procurement@novamed.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -07:00

Hi Lauren / Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks — we've scheduled the portal upload for tomorrow AM. A couple of clarifications from Finance: 
- Our PO numbering convention requires an estimated total before staged commits. Can you provide a single-line estimated invoice amount for Q1 (to place on the PO)?
- Any objections to net-30 on the first invoice and net-60 on the final invoice (staggered payments tied to staged uplift)?

We'll also need the DocuSign envelope to include both the SOW amendment and the Service Level Addendum (SLA) as separate documents. Please confirm SLA version number so we can link it.

Regards,
Elena (on behalf of NovaMed Procurement)

[Attachment stub: procurement-template_novamed.xlsx]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: procurement@novamed.com <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — onboarding refresh + PO timing

Elena —

Answers below and final checklist:

1) Single-line estimated invoice amount for Q1: $42,500 (this reflects base subscription plus first staged 5% uplift). Use that as the PO estimate.
2) Net terms: we accept net-30 for first invoice and net-60 on the final invoice for this staged cadence — no objection.
3) SLA: use version 3.1 (attached in the SOW package). We'll include both the SOW amendment and SLA v3.1 in the DocuSign envelope.

Actions we've completed:
- Pre-filled PO template live in the portal (please input PO number and submit).
- Evidence checklist uploaded to portal (you can reference the filenames Jordan provided).
- DocuSign envelope created and pending internal legal sign-off (expect link Monday morning if Friday legal misses sign-off).

If procurement wants to accelerate, Marissa can start invoicing on the first net-30 invoice as soon as the PO is submitted — let us know the PO number and we'll queue invoices.

Thanks — Lauren

[Attachment stubs: NovaMed_SOW_rev2.pdf (PDF), SLA_v3.1.pdf (PDF), renewal-evidence-bundle-2028-10-10.zip (zip)]
